# KT Messenger

> KT Messenger is a free, secure messaging and calling app for private chats,
> voice calls, video calls, real-time messaging, and seamless communication
> across devices - available worldwide.

[KT Messenger](https://ktmessenger.com): the global communication platform for
messaging, calling, sharing, and staying connected with people around the world.
Available in over 180 countries.

## Features

- [Calling](https://ktmessenger.com/video-calling-app): free HD voice and video
calls with end-to-end encryption, group calls, and screen sharing.
- [Messaging](https://ktmessenger.com/messaging-app): fast private messaging with
instant chat, photos, videos, files, voice notes, and 2GB attachments.
- [Groups](https://ktmessenger.com/group-chat-app): group chats and communities
up to 1024 members with admin controls, polls, and events.
- [Channels](https://ktmessenger.com/social-media-platform): one-to-many
broadcast channels for announcements, creators, and brands.
- [KT AI](https://ktmessenger.com/ai-assistant-app): built-in AI assistant for
answers, image generation, translation across 100+ languages, and smart search.
- [Status](https://ktmessenger.com/social-feed-app): 24-hour disappearing photo,
video, and voice status updates.
- [Security](https://ktmessenger.com/secure-messaging-app): end-to-end
encryption by default, biometric chat locks, and passcode protection.
- [KT Plus](https://ktmessenger.com/premium-messaging-app): premium tier with
10GB file sharing, custom themes, and the Stealth Privacy Suite.
- [Notes](https://ktmessenger.com/notes-app): synced notes with rich formatting
inside the app.
- [Minis](https://ktmessenger.com/minis-short-video-app): short-form video feed
to watch, create, and share clips with the community.
- [Community](https://ktmessenger.com/community): the social networking and
instant messaging platform for building connections and communities.

## Pages

- [Apps & Downloads](https://ktmessenger.com/messaging-app-download): KT
Messenger apps for Android, iPhone, Mac, and PC, plus the KT Web version.
- [Privacy](https://ktmessenger.com/private-messaging-app): how KT Messenger
protects conversations with encryption, privacy controls, and safe settings.
- [Blog](https://ktmessenger.com/messaging-social-media-blog): product updates,
feature announcements, and engineering write-ups.
- [Help Center](https://ktmessenger.com/messaging-app-help): guides, FAQs, and
support articles for every platform.
- [For Business](https://ktmessenger.com/business-messaging-app): the KT
Business platform for customer conversations, catalogs, and broadcasts.
